CORRECT-BEHAVIOR VARIANTS, OBSERVED IN-TREE BEFORE INVERSION
============================================================

This is NOT a run of the committed tests. The committed reproductions in
jsx_layout_test.go assert today's MEASURED BROKEN behavior and they PASS.

This file records the run that came first. Each defect assertion was authored in
its CORRECT-BEHAVIOR form — what the fixed matcher must do — and run against the
unfixed tree, to confirm the failure is the one the defect predicts rather than a
setup error. Only after this run was each assertion inverted to state the
observed brokenness and its JSX-LAYOUT-ANCHOR set to broken.

Every control and known-positive assertion in the run below PASSED; only the two
defect-bearing assertions failed, on both JSX grammars. That split is what
distinguishes real red from a harness that never exercised the subject, and each
half is worth naming:

  - In both reproductions the control is a require, so it aborts its subtest
    before the defect assertion is read. All four controls passed: the same
    child with no preceding newline matches (1), and the same element with no
    whitespace before its closing tag matches (1). The zeros below are therefore
    genuine refusals over reachable fixtures, not dead probes.
  - TestJSXLayoutKnownPositives passed in full, all nine rows. Space-separated,
    adjacent, outside-a-JSX-parent and jsx_text-bearing sources all match on both
    grammars, so the failures are specific to newline-bearing whitespace in JSX
    child position rather than a pattern that matches nothing anywhere.

The four observed failures, each the defect's predicted one — the same shape on
tsx and on javascript, which is the measurement that puts javascript in scope:

  TestJSXLayoutNewlineChild/tsx_newline_child
  TestJSXLayoutNewlineChild/javascript_newline_child
      "[]" should have 1 item(s), but has 0
      a newline before a JSX child is layout, not a constraint — the pattern
      must reach it

  TestJSXLayoutNewlineBeforeClosingTag/tsx_newline_before_closing_tag
  TestJSXLayoutNewlineBeforeClosingTag/javascript_newline_before_closing_tag
      "[]" should have 1 item(s), but has 0
      the newline before a closing tag is absorbed into the `</` token and must
      not constrain the match
